Gerona is a city in Catalia.

On the author’s map

It is labeled on the author’s world map in northern Catalia, beside the fortress of Indra and south of the border with Ollandia. The name does not occur in the first book’s text, so neither its role nor its population is known. The nearest described stretches of the journey are Kabarda—a land known for its stubborn men, quarrelsome bulls, and bickering women—and the border fortress of Indra (ch. 4), through which the railway from Laerta to Ollandia passes.
